title: Kombu Kissed French Kombu Quiche
description: A salty, flaky French quiche featuring kombu, perfect for a brunch mood, this dish is jain-friendly and boiled to perfection.

ingredients.name: kombu
ingredients.notes: dried and cut into small pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the pie crust and place it in a tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
In a large bowl, whisk together the tofu, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked mushroom mixture and chopped kombu to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the filling mixture into the pie crust.
Bake the quiche for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove the quiche from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
